title: Last Lap
hook: Final lap. 400 km/h. And he's 0.1 seconds behind the best racer in Hyperlane

messages.text: Final lap. Four hundred kilometers an hour. And Jay was one tenth of a second behind the best racer in Hyperlane.
messages.label: LAP 3/3 · P2

messages.text: Nice try, rookie. Nobody passes me on the last lap.
Three minutes earlier, nobody even knew his name. Six racers. One neon city. And Jay started dead last.
messages.label: 3 MINUTES EARLIER

messages.text: So he did what the pros do. He drifted every corner. Blue boost. Orange boost. Purple boost.
messages.label: LAP 1/3 · P6

messages.text: Jay, you're up to fourth! Keep filling that Overdrive!
Into the ice valley, under a living aurora. Through every light gate, until his Overdrive was full. Only Vex was ahead. And Vex... plays dirty.
messages.label: LAP 2/3 · P3

messages.text: Vex swerved right across his nose. Jay clipped the wall. Sparks everywhere. And the finish line was coming up fast.
messages.label: LAP 3/3 · P2

messages.text: Come on, come on, come on!
He tucked in right behind Vex. Slipstream. Closer... closer... and then he hit Overdrive.
They crossed the line side by side. The screen froze... photo finish.
And the winner was... Jay. By three thousandths of a second.
This is Hyperlane. Free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game, so play it on a computer. Think you can beat Vex?
